# Third-party assets

* **IBM Plex Sans Arabic** (SIL Open Font License 1.1), self-hosted through the npm package `@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans-arabic@5.3.0` (weights 400, 500, 600). The package licence text (OFL-1.1 and the IBM copyright) is kept here as required when the fonts are redistributed: [IBM-Plex-Sans-Arabic-OFL-1.1-LICENSE.txt](IBM-Plex-Sans-Arabic-OFL-1.1-LICENSE.txt). See [ADR-0002](../localization/ADR-0002-arabic-font.md).
